notable_absence.finding: The page never reconciles its own 'available for both editions' claim with cbbackupmgr's Enterprise-only packaging note two paragraphs later ('In Couchbase Enterprise Server 7.2 and later, cbbackupmgr is available in the Tools package that must be downloaded') - it names the download package 'Enterprise Server' in the same breath as calling the tool available on Community, without explaining whether Community users get the same Tools package under a different name or a different distribution path at all.

cross_component_finding: Direct contradiction with the tool's own overview page. This page states: 'Only Full Administrators can use `cbbackupmgr`; which is available for both Couchbase Server Enterprise Edition and Couchbase Server Community Edition.' cbbackupmgr.md's AUTHORS section states the opposite: 'cbbackupmgr is a Couchbase Enterprise Edition tool and was written by Couchbase.' Separately, this page's own Full-Administrator-only claim is itself narrower than what cbbackupmgr-backup.md's RBAC section documents: that page states bucket-level backup/restore may be performed by a user holding only the `data_backup` (Data Backup & Restore) role, with cluster-level metadata (Analytics Synonyms, Eventing Metadata, FTS Aliases) requiring the specific admin roles for those services (analytics_admin, eventing_admin, fts_admin) rather than Full Admin. So within this one module there are three different, mutually inconsistent statements of who may run cbbackupmgr and under which edition.
